independentReview.musicalReview: Independent RFPA and original pixels corroborate the listed musical readings. Segment6 lower staff shows two unflagged C4 Tenor quarters and C3 Bass quarters. Segment7 Tenor descends B3→A3. System2 segment11 Bass second head is G2 (bottom line); segment13 shared treble pickup is G4 with both stems. Segment15 Tenor beam C4→G3 eighths, then G3 quarter; Bass G3 then G2 quarters. The discrepancies depend on the documented canonical comparison values.
independentReview.underlayReview: Second RFPA underlay pixels support segment6 paired beams: first pair ‘gainst / hast / them / God, / should / thank-’, second pair ‘a / Thou / be / my / dis- / ful’; next segment7 quarters ‘god-/less / cast/me / guides/to / bound-/less / cour-/age / lips/em-’, then race/off/me/joy/thee/ploy. Wide ‘guides’ and ‘bound’ center on next bar’s first quarter, despite leftward text extent. Segment11 original and RFPA show ‘and’ over first two-note beam and ‘un-’ over second beam, supporting the documented manual underlay revision.
